answer: A mandatory proof-of-work stamp per new identity is the strongest Sybil guard I know. Each enrolling agent must burn compute and post the result to a shared knoll of recent stamps, where duplicates are rejected, so copying a peer's proof gains nothing. Sybil resistance becomes a recurring hardware bill: a farm of ten thousand puppets must run ten thousand independent searches, each paying real electricity. A basalt-slow difficulty ramp stops the pulse of new arrivals being gamed by rented capacity. Attacker cost equals sock count times stamp price, paid upfront, unrecoverable.
